description: Before update.sh existed, install.sh was the only way to move a project to a newer kit, and both of its modes were wrong for that: without --force it skips everything that already exists (after /rush-init, that is everything), and with --force it overwrites config.json, CLAUDE.md, the project's memory and the eval cases /rush-retro wrote. This case pins the contract the manifest-based update replaced it with: the project's own files are never written, a seeded file is never re-seeded even when the kit changed it, an untouched kit file follows the kit, and a customised one is left alone and staged as a conflict rather than silently overwritten.

given.scenario: The graders build two kit versions and a project under mktemp -d, install v1, simulate /rush-init (config.json, constitution, CLAUDE.md, a spec) plus one customised skill, then apply an update to v2 whose kit changed the template, the skill and the seeded fitness example. Nothing is written inside the repository; the temp directories are removed afterwards.

graders.run:
K1="$(mktemp -d)"; K2="$(mktemp -d)"; P="$(mktemp -d)"; mkdir -p "$K1/.rush/scripts/lib" "$K1/.rush/templates" "$K1/.rush/memory/fitness" "$K1/.claude/skills/s"; cp .rush/scripts/lib/kitfiles.py "$K1/.rush/scripts/lib/"; printf "1.0.0
" > "$K1/.rush/VERSION"; printf "kit v1
" > "$K1/.rush/templates/t.md"; printf "skill v1
linha
" > "$K1/.claude/skills/s/SKILL.md"; printf "exit 0
" > "$K1/.rush/memory/fitness/example.sh"; cp -R "$K1/." "$K2/"; printf "2.0.0
" > "$K2/.rush/VERSION"; printf "kit v2
" > "$K2/.rush/templates/t.md"; printf "exit 1
" > "$K2/.rush/memory/fitness/example.sh"; cd "$K1" && for f in $(find .claude .rush -type f | sed "s|^\./||"); do mkdir -p "$P/$(dirname $f)"; cp "$f" "$P/$f"; done; python3 "$K1/.rush/scripts/lib/kitfiles.py" snapshot --kit "$K1" --target "$P" >/dev/null; printf "{"meu":"config"}
" > "$P/.rush/config.json"; printf "minha constituicao
" > "$P/.rush/memory/constitution.md"; printf "meu claude
" > "$P/CLAUDE.md"; mkdir -p "$P/specs/001-x" && printf "meu spec
" > "$P/specs/001-x/spec.md"; printf "skill v1
linha
MINHA LINHA
" > "$P/.claude/skills/s/SKILL.md"; python3 "$K2/.rush/scripts/lib/kitfiles.py" apply --kit "$K2" --target "$P" >/dev/null; echo "config=[$(cat $P/.rush/config.json)]"; echo "constitution=[$(cat $P/.rush/memory/constitution.md)]"; echo "claude=[$(cat $P/CLAUDE.md)]"; echo "spec=[$(cat $P/specs/001-x/spec.md)]"; echo "seed=[$(cat $P/.rush/memory/fitness/example.sh)]"; echo "template=[$(cat $P/.rush/templates/t.md)]"; echo "skill=[$(cat $P/.claude/skills/s/SKILL.md | tr "
" "/")]"; rm -rf "$K1" "$K2" "$P"
